profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Bidlo
profile.summary:
• Current full-stack developer with an emphasis on data
• Former D1 decathlete & current aspiring triathlete
• B.S. Mechanical Eng. & Minor in Computer Science
• Located in Knoxville, TN

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Own core product data systems from source evaluation through production support.
• Led a two-platform database migration, preserving data integrity and reliability.
• Own the data lifecycle: sourcing, collection, transformation, deployment, and debugging.
• Build full-stack features that process and expose customer data.
• Serve as a forward-deployed engineer, resolving customer issues and driving product improvements.
• Partner with Sales, HR, and leadership on requirements, tradeoffs, and business priorities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Tasked with gathering customer-requested data from a range of services, formats, styles, and organizations. 
• Expanded and created production-ready code and scripts into existing customer pipelines in requested formats.
• Planned future database styles, removed tech-debt, and assisted in teaching coding methods.
• Primarily completed in Python, Postgresql, and JavaScript.
positions.insights: Software Design, Web Engineering and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: Software Infrastructure, Software Design and +6 skills

positions.title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
positions.description: Overall problem solving and production trend improvements in all areas of aluminum die-casting, CNC machining, washing, assembly, and verification testing. Cycle time improvements to increase takt time, data gathering to present in formal reports for review by companies such as Ford Motor Company and Toyota Motor Corporation, and designing zero gauge tools for different assembly machines using CAD software such as Solidworks. I also took part in many internal company meetings dealing with finances, product testing and improvement, and well as prioritizing manufacturing details.

projects.title: Conversation Pace
projects.description:
conversationpace.com

Athlete-centered activity manager w/ Generation, analysis, and storage. Full group features and achievements for the focused athlete and the newbie

projects.title: Bibledoku
projects.description: A colleague and I created a Bible-themed trivia game! There is a new puzzle generated daily, and the results can be shared.
